text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 a tonne higher on hot, dry Prairie weather and firmer CBOT soycomplex calls. Technical resistance seen in the November at C$355.50, then C$357.50. Funds were expected to resume buying November with hedges expected in the August and November. November WCE canola crush profit margin rose to -4.00 Tuesday from -5.38 Monday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3835, rose to 85.91 yen and rose to 1.3323 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on spillover support.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne higher on higher CBOT corn calls but gains seen limited by expected farmer hedges.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.30 up on higher CBOT corn calls and calls for some CBOT wheat contracts to move higher. Commercial selling was expected at C$154 in the October and December.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
